literature.title: State-independent proof of Kochen-Specker theorem with 13 rays
literature.location: Visible equation (1), page 2; Figure 2 gives the orthogonality graph.
literature.inspection: The versioned PDF was visually rendered and checked. Its hidden parsed text also contains an older equation number; visible Eq.(1) is used. The paper is a provenance source, not an executed or redistributed replay input.
literature.mapping: All nonzero vectors in {-1,0,1}^3 modulo sign, represented by first nonzero coordinate +1 and sorted lexicographically. Paper h1=(-1,1,1) is represented by its negative (1,-1,-1); other listed rays already have the chosen sign. All scalar products and zero relations are checked from these integer representatives.
